## **B1C1: The Well**
- Collect different "ore" and fill a bucket, remove layers. The bucket fill rate can be increased through various content in the cavern ⚠️  (where? e.g. Chests)
- You can adjust the bucket to Collect X rock or to Remove Rock Layers to unlock other rocks.

Filling bucket with rocks:
- The bucket has a base cap, like 0/100 
- The Rocks can be spent on opals or Schematics

Increase Bucket Capacity:
- Schematic 6 "Bar Expand-o-Rama" costs 100 rocks (your current cap) which unlocks a toggle in the Well UI "Expand Full Bars". You will need to enable this pretty soon to afford the next upgrades. 
- Each time it is FULL it will spend 50% of your rocks and increase your cap by 50%. So you will need to reach 100/100 rocks, you will then get it to 50/150. Either spend or wait for more rocks. 
- HOWEVER you must be online (any world) for it to continuously upgrade. 
If you are fully offline, for days, weeks, months, and come back, it will only notice that 1 single capacity level up, take half your rocks, give 50% more cap.


Removing a Layer:
- Set the bucket to remove a Layer which unlocks the next rocks
- Once the layer is removed, the bucket will automatically switch to collecting the newly unlocked rock type.
- Then you can fill that new rock type in the bucket for unlocking schematics

Rock Names:
- Gravel > Goldust > Redstone > Mythril > Cobaltine > Bruntine > Freezium

Play around with the amplifiers, 250k Def should easily get you to 40-50x in amplifier 1. ⚠️ Not much tested here.

Tell me a Story:
- Unlock Bonuses based on your progress (winning fights) and your Reward multi.
- You have a Damage range (3-25 Damage at start) per Sword. Need to defeat the enemy for bonuses.
- You start with 3 swords (can unlock more later)
- Click each of your swords to hit the enemy and gain bonuses
- If you DIE / lose, you will NOT gain any bonuses you obtained in that run!
- To keep your bonuses you must "RUN" from the fight.
- The bonuses are random, if you see an opal (especially early on) don't risk losing the round and make sure you Run in time.
- You can try this every 20h. The 2h time skip lanterns decrease this, nothing else does except time.
- When you unlock the 300h "rethrow swords" you can only rethrow a sword BEFORE you throw the next one. This means you CANNOT rethrow previous swords if you already moved on. This Means if you throw Swords 1, 2, 3 in a row, you can only rethrow sword 3. The final sword can only be rethrown, if the current max damage is higher than the remaining health.
- The "First Try, I Swear" Schematic from engineer means you should throw your furthest right sword to stack more dmg. Typically stop when enemy health is around 5% of your max dmg. (e.g if you have 1mil dmg, stop trying when the enemy is at around 50k hp). As if you fail to 1 shot the enemy with that sword you lose your stacked damage buff. So you then throw your other swords first from then on. If you use another sword before your last one, it doesn't matter if you don't kill the enemy yet, you won't lose your damage buff.

## **B2C6: The Harp**
**Strings**: A multiplier on how many of anything you gain,  get more strings from Conjuror (Hole Majik) and Schematic 20. 
**Notes**: Unlocked by turning in other notes at the Harp and these are used for Schematics, Measurements etc.
**Letters**: Unlocked through Schematic 21 and others ⚠️ ? and have different purposes.

- **Can't do anything until Harp Power reaches 100%+**
- Once at 100%+ You can "Pluck" (Mouse/finger drag over) the Strings, and you gain notes based on the Letter setting.
- Make sure you pluck every string you have on the screen before leaving area, easiest to just mouse/finger swipe over all. But you can pluck them individually and adjust notes/letters at any time while plucking them 1 by 1 (min maxing)
- Harp Power stacks above 100%  (meaning you could have like 240%+ as a random example)
- Seems Harp charge was about 5% per 1.5min so   100% = 30minute wait.  (this will later be decreased through Schematic and unlocking Letter "E")
- Each time you pluck the strings, the assigned letter gains XP based on the Harp Power % which gives passive bonuses (more notes, harp power,..)
- You can see the level bonuses by clicking "Adjust Strings" then clicking the different letters on the right"
- You can also pluck a few strings on 1 Note, then switch the note midway and pluck the others!

Tips:
- You want to Balance C and D early on for their passive note gain bonuses per level
- Depending on your Engineer level you want to start saving up for Schematic 20+21 which cost 183 and 259 Note 1,  Schematic 20 is an extra string, schematic 21 is Letter E (Harp Power Charge Speed). ## **Jar Production Explained** 
**Huge credit to __<@145345732763844608>__ for breaking this all down to me a million times**
**NOTE:** The Jar is a lot more complex for upgrading to 10x, 100x, 1000x,... the Schematic doesn't actually do anything! Gilded is also weird.
**TLDR:**
- You only upgrade Jar size once the whole zone is filled with jars (if online), there's 120 spaces, each jar after is a 10% for the next size. The complex part, only if you produce enough jars within its check timer will it upgrade to the next jar. You can only get 1x or 10x Jars online, and higher (100x +) jars when offline/time skips. Explained later.

**INFO:**
- Jar Size: Small = 1x, Medium = 10x, Large = 100x, Giant = 1000x, ?⚠️(name) ⚠️ ? = 10000x   *(I am giving names for the jars)*
- There's 120 Spaces for Jars on the board / the zone (Zone/board = Jar map)
- A cycle check time is 5s while off the map, 0.2s while on the map and checks each of your 3 producing jar slots individually (maybe relevant later)
- If you are on C11, you will visually only see Small jars, must refresh map to see them upgraded, this is technically more complex, but the easiest way to explain it. Might change a lot if we get more jar speed.

**__How upgrading Jars works?__** 
- This works different between Active (online) vs Offline.
- If board has less than 120 jars, create a small (1x) jar, simple.
- Once the board is full with 120 jars, there's a 10% chance to upgrade your "lowest" small (1x) jar to a Medium (10x) jar.

**__Production: Active or Offline (Always a thing)__** 
- If the board is full, each jar you make has a 10% chance to make an additional jar that is the next size up!

**__Production: ACTIVE__**  *(Game is open)*
- You can only produce small (1x) jars with the additional 10% chance to make a medium (10x) jar IF the board is full.
- E.g. You need to fill the board with 120 small (1x) jars, the next produced jar (1x) has a 10% chance to turn into a medium (10x) jar. This happens for each jar produced.
- **You can only make 1x or 10x Jars while online**, *(unless we get enough jar speed to produce 10+ Jars from a single production slot within a cycle check time is 5s)*

**__Production: OFFLINE__**  *(Game is closed)*
- Each "Producing" Jar slot is calculated individually, the 1 to 3 different jars we can produce.
- The board is somewhat irrelevant, you could have 0 or up to 120 jars, however 120 jars is still better.
- The jars produced will calculated from highest jar possible to lowest jar, and convert in that order.
- More explained under the image. https://discord.com/channels/437797104786604034/1303761365273415700/1303761806795214969

Whenever you open a gilded jar, your multiplier is set to the highest of the following two numbers
- `1 + 3^jarQuality`
- `currentMulti + 0.1`

`jarQuality` is 0 for a 1x jar, 1 for a 10x jar, 2 for a 100x jar, and so on.

**Example:**  My multi starts at 1 and I open the following Jars in order.
I open a (1x) gilded jar

I open another (1x)

I open a (10x) jar.
- My multi could either go to 4 or 2.2, so it goes to 4.
I open a (1x) jar.
- My multi could either go to 2 or 4.1, so it goes to 4.1.
I open a (10x) jar.
- My multi could either go to 4 or 4.2, so it goes to 4.2.
**Best strategy**, build up a (10x) Jar as your starting point, and use that FIRST, your starting multi is set to 4x, then break all the other gilded jars, just break them as (1x) non stop.
